create_deep_cfr_solver: create a DeepCFRSolver instance for an OpenSpiel game with configurable network layers and training parameters
train_deep_cfr_model: train a Deep CFR solver on a game by calling solve to traverse the game tree and learn advantage and policy networks
build_reservoir_buffer: build a ReservoirBuffer for uniform sampling over advantage or strategy experience data with configurable capacity
build_mlp_network: build an MLP neural network with configurable hidden layer sizes and optional final activation for advantage or policy approximation
get_action_probabilities: get action probabilities for a game state using the trained policy network with legal action filtering
